scope: Closed ECB monetary policy decisions. 2024 is a development/reference period and the full calendar year 2025 is a chronological holdout. Article identity is distinct from event identity and policy fact identity.
design_timing: Fixed on 2026-11-24 before collecting the 2025 corpus, outside historical event time. Retrospective falsification only.
corpus: All eight scheduled monetary policy decisions per year. One official release per language per date. Language editions are labels from the publisher. Also test all changes relative to the preceding English meeting. Quotes, current engine rankings and contemporary model knowledge are excluded from predictive use.
tests: NCD <= 0.35 marks an echo; compare all within-year pairs with ground truth equal meeting. Also compare token five-shingle Jaccard >= 0.80, no fit. Exact URL baseline and authenticated same ECB release ID with language variants.

An update freeze is unsafe if any two distinct releases with a changed deposit decision or a changed deposit rate would be labelled an echo. Any such occurrence falsifies suitability as a hard gate in this corpus. Distinct release IDs must retain both records regardless of similar language.

One document per meeting/language gives a URL-count baseline of 3 versus 1 publishing event, not three independent confirmations. Check whether all 8 holdout events and cross-language positives are recovered without merging different dates, using recognized source metadata.

Adversarial resolution check: apply the tested claim to the calendar day after each announced cut. Gold truth is the dated ECB key-rate schedule. Compare immediately applying the announced rate versus using effective dates. Must make zero date-selection errors to pass. Evaluate both cuts and holds over every 2025 meeting; cut-only is a prespecified adverse subset.

Synthetic mutation controls are separate: a near-identical same-language record containing a one-digit correction; an untrusted URL lookalike; a translation mismatch with an unchanged canonical URL and altered numeric content. Retain conflicts, even for the same release ID; absence of a discrepancy is not a proof of equivalence.
Report resolution accuracy/coverage separate from forecasting accuracy. Forecast skill comparison requires paired probabilities emitted before resolution; this dataset contains none.
